label: 引导前清场
js: refresh(); root.closeLobbyTerminalPanel(); root.terminalReturn = null; if (root.worldDialog) root.closeWorldDialog(); if (root.worldPoiDialog) root.closeWorldPoiDialog(); if (root.evolutionPick) root.closeEvolutionPickLater(); localStorage.removeItem('lc_feature_intro_{UID}'); root.featureIntros.uid = 0; localStorage.removeItem('lc_story_guide_skip_{UID}_V04'); localStorage.removeItem('lc_story_guide_skip_{UID}_V05'); root.storyGuideDone.clear(); await sleep(1500); return JSON.stringify({ view: view(), intro: root.featureIntroOpen });

label: 模拟接到V04
js: refresh(); const q = root.worldState.quests.find(x => x.code === 'V04'); window.__guideSaved = root.worldState.quests.filter(x => x.code === 'V04' || x.code === 'V05').map(x => ({ code: x.code, state: x.state, progress: x.progress })); q.state = 'ACCEPTED'; q.progress = 0; root.refreshLobbyViewPreservingBackground(); await sleep(4500); return JSON.stringify(window.__guideSaved);

label: 第一次开终端_说明卡
js: refresh(); root.openLobbyTerminalPanel(); for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { await sleep(300); if (root.featureIntroOpen) break; } await sleep(600); return JSON.stringify({ intro: root.featureIntroOpen, guide: !!find('LobbyGuideOverlay') });

label: 说明卡点知道了
js: refresh(); const layer = root.node.getChildByName('LobbyFeatureIntroLayer'); let ok = null; if (layer) layer.walk(n => { if (!ok && n.name === 'Ok') ok = n; }); tap(ok); await sleep(800); return JSON.stringify({ tapped: !!ok, intro: root.featureIntroOpen, seen: root.featureIntros.seen('terminal') });

label: 终端进召唤_免费召唤强引导
js: refresh(); root.runLobbyTerminalAction('gacha'); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { await sleep(500); if (find('LobbyGuideOverlay')) break; } await sleep(1500); return JSON.stringify({ view: view(), guide: !!find('LobbyGuideOverlay'), skip: !!find('GuideSkip'), free: root.gachaFreeSingleAvailable() });

label: 跳过引导_重绘不再出
js: refresh(); tap(find('GuideSkip')); await sleep(800); const gone = !find('LobbyGuideOverlay'); root.renderCurrentView(); await sleep(1500); return JSON.stringify({ gone, again: !!find('LobbyGuideOverlay'), blocked: root.storyGuideBlocked('V04') });

label: 回大厅_模拟接到V05
js: refresh(); root.closeGachaScene(); for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { await sleep(300); if (view() === 'lobby') break; } await sleep(2500); refresh(); root.closeLobbyTerminalPanel(); root.terminalReturn = null; const q4 = root.worldState.quests.find(x => x.code === 'V04'); const q5 = root.worldState.quests.find(x => x.code === 'V05'); q4.state = 'CLAIMED'; q5.state = 'ACCEPTED'; q5.progress = 0; root.refreshLobbyViewPreservingBackground(); await sleep(1500); return JSON.stringify({ view: view(), v05: q5.state });

label: 终端聚光英雄格
js: refresh(); root.openLobbyTerminalPanel(); for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { await sleep(300); if (find('LobbyGuideOverlay')) break; } await sleep(800); return JSON.stringify({ guide: !!find('LobbyGuideOverlay'), intro: root.featureIntroOpen });

label: 点英雄格_名册聚光第一位伙伴
js: refresh(); tap(find('LobbyTerminalHit_Tile_heroes')); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { await sleep(500); if (view() === 'heroes' && find('LobbyHeroRosterCard_0') && find('LobbyGuideOverlay')) break; } await sleep(1200); return JSON.stringify({ view: view(), card: !!find('LobbyHeroRosterCard_0'), guide: !!find('LobbyGuideOverlay') });

label: 点伙伴_详情聚光升级
js: refresh(); tap(find('LobbyHeroRosterCard_0')); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { await sleep(500); if (view() === 'heroDetail' && root.heroDetailLevelUpAffordable() !== null && find('LobbyHeroDetailLevelUpButton')) break; } await sleep(1500); root.renderCurrentView(); await sleep(1500); return JSON.stringify({ view: view(), affordable: root.heroDetailLevelUpAffordable(), protagonist: root.heroDetailIsProtagonist(), guide: !!find('LobbyGuideOverlay') });

label: 点升级_引导当场收起
js: refresh(); const had = !!find('LobbyGuideOverlay'); const btn = find('LobbyHeroDetailLevelUpButton'); tap(btn); for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { await sleep(400); if (!find('LobbyGuideOverlay')) break; } await sleep(1500); return JSON.stringify({ had, gone: !find('LobbyGuideOverlay'), done: root.storyGuideDone.has('V05') });

label: 回大厅_世界状态回读
js: refresh(); root.returnToLobbyFromScenePage(); for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { await sleep(400); if (view() === 'lobby') break; } await sleep(3000); refresh(); return JSON.stringify(root.worldState.quests.filter(x => x.code === 'V04' || x.code === 'V05').map(x => x.code + ':' + x.state));

label: 背包说明卡
js: refresh(); root.closeLobbyTerminalPanel(); root.terminalReturn = null; root.openLobbyBagPanel(); for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { await sleep(300); if (root.featureIntroOpen) break; } await sleep(700); return root.featureIntroOpen;

label: 背包知道了回大厅
js: refresh(); root.dismissFeatureIntroCard(true); root.returnToLobbyFromScenePage(); await sleep(1500); return JSON.stringify({ seen: root.featureIntros.seen('bag'), view: view() });
